answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. The way a jetty roots the soil, a sparrow returns each spring, and a copper reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
